messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — summarizing action items for the auth + model-registry outage Sunday. We identified 3 repeat patterns (token refresh storms, model-registry write contention, and cross-region failover gaps). Owners and rough timelines below. Please ACK and update if you need more runway.

sam: Action list: 
1) Priya — implement token cache with backoff + jitter (deploy canary by Thu EOD).
2) Tyler — model-registry write queue refactor (spike this week, full rollout in 2 sprints).
3) Lina — emergency fallback routing for read-only cached manifests + runbook update (runbook rehearsal next Wed).
4) Maria — verify cloud-provider circuit break thresholds & cross-region fallback tests (test plan by Tue).
5) sam — coordinate vendor SLA request and vendor escalation playbook (send template to legal + vendor ops today).

sam: NOTE: owners should add themselves to the incident action tracker spreadsheet and set a hard ETA column. We'll use that to gate canaries.

maria: ACK. I'll draft the cross-region test steps and add specific success criteria (cold-start < 150ms, failover < 800ms).

tyler: ACK on queue refactor. Spike will include a prototype using a small Redis-backed buffer + idempotency keys. ETA for spike: EOD Fri. Question: do we want to preserve current write path as opt-in flag?

sam: @tyler yes keep opt-in behind feature flag. We'll run canary on a small tenancy segment first.

priya: Taking token cache/backoff. I'll add a PoC branch and post a short RFC in devex channel. Quick plan: 
- add local LRU cache + singleflight suppression
- exponential backoff with random jitter on 429/401 responses
- metric: token refresh rate per minute
Target canary: Thu.

lina: Re: runbook rehearsal — I'll own the dry-run. devops-bot can you schedule a 30m test window next Wed 09:00 UTC and add checklist items?

devops-bot: Scheduled: Runbook rehearsal 'auth+model-registry fallback' on 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC. Notifying @oncall and creating ephemeral channel #incident-rehearsal-3199. Reminder: include vendor contact numbers in the runbook. 

tyler: For model-registry write contention, proposing a short-term mitigation: limit concurrent writers per region and add backpressure HTTP header to clients. This should reduce tail latency while we refactor.

maria: Adding to cloud test plan — I'll try simulated token storms (10k/s) and verify our circuit opens within expected thresholds. If not, we escalate to vendor.

priya: Quick snippet I'll add to the SDK to reduce thundering herd: 
```
const token = await tokenCache.getOrRefresh(key)
// singleflight ensures only 1 refresh per key in flight
```

lina: Can we confirm who will be primary vs backup pager during the rehearsal? I'll volunteer as backup. 

sam: I'll be primary for the rehearsal. @lina backup. Also listing acceptance criteria for each action in the tracker: deploy smoke passes, metrics show 90% reduction in refresh ops for canaried users, no increased error-rate in 24h window.

maria: One more note: vendor escalation template — we should request historical auth latency logs for the incident window and ask for a post-incident RCA. I'll draft template and drop in #vendors.

tyler: Will add a feature-flag toggle and a quick rollback path in the deployment notes.

priya: If anyone wants to pair on the SDK change, ping me. I can carve out an hour tomorrow.

sam: Great. Next sync: brief check-in after the spike (Fri standup) and a rehearsal retrospective after the runbook drill. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
